business: Mitra (beta), creators and a customer counter for Bengaluru local businesses
target: Owners or managers of independent cafés, darshinis, salons, gyms and boutiques in South and Central Bengaluru that have tried or considered Instagram creators
where: Bengaluru (Jayanagar, Basavanagudi, Malleshwaram, Koramangala, HSR, Indiranagar)

segments.name: Single-outlet café or darshini, owner runs the counter
Salon, gym or boutique, owner plus 2-10 staff
Small chain (2-5 outlets) or new D2C brand with a marketing person

behaviours.name: Barter veteran
behaviours.how: Gives free meals to creators often; not sure it brings anyone.

behaviours.name: Burned by influencers
behaviours.how: Paid a creator, saw likes but no customers; now skeptical.

behaviours.name: Word-of-mouth only
behaviours.how: Relies on regulars and Google reviews; never tried creators.

behaviours.name: Uses an agency
behaviours.how: Pays a local agency or freelancer to handle Instagram.

behaviours.name: Tech-shy
behaviours.how: Uses WhatsApp and UPI, avoids new apps and logins.

behaviours.name: Numbers-minded
behaviours.how: Tracks daily sales in a book or Petpooja; wants proof before spending.

objections: My staff won't remember to redeem coupons when it's busy
Customers won't bother showing a coupon
Free now, but you'll start charging once I depend on it
I already get creators asking for free food every week
I don't have time to learn another app

Who are you? A new startup could disappear
habits: you are at the counter from 7 am to 2 pm
you get 3 or 4 Instagram DMs a week from creators asking for a free meal
you check UPI settlements every evening
your nephew handles your Instagram page
